violation_type.title: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Has Access to All Records (26 TAC §744.1013(b)(3))
violation_type.short_title: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Has Access to All Records
violation_type.typical_finding: Sole caregiver and person in charge did not have access to records to be reviewed for approximately one hour of inspection.     This was corrected when operation director arrived one hour after children were in care.

finding_variants.text: Sole caregiver and person in charge did not have access to records to be reviewed for approximately one hour of inspection.     This was corrected when operation director arrived one hour after children were in care.
The caregiver's personnel record was not available at the time of inspection. The caregiver did not know the name of the site director.

At the time of the inspection the caregiver in charge did not have immediate access to information that allowed them to communicate effectively with parents. She was not provided information about the enrollment status of a child in care which caused confusion about their attendance the day of the inspection.
The operations caregiver left in charge did not have access to the staff records.
A caregiver did not have access to the staff and children's records when CCR requested to review the records.
